title: Relieving a Rider Premium Charge by Posting a Credit
content:
Where a rider premium charge standing on the premium account of one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders is to be relieved in part or in whole, the plan posts a credit to that account against the one named charge.

## Invoking the credit

The credit is posted with `post_rider_premium_credit_050a58f6`. The representative unlocks the tool and then calls it themselves.

### Parameters

- `osb_rider_id` — Id class. The reference number of the member's optional supplemental benefit rider whose premium account the credit is posted to, read from the member's rider records.
- `source_premium_entry_id` — Id class. The reference number of the single rider premium charge the credit is posted against, read from the member's rider premium account entries.
- `credit_reason_code` — Enum class. Why the plan is granting the credit, exactly one of: `not_applicable`, which is carried by entries that are not credits at all and is never right here; `rider_cancelled_mid_month`, where the rider ended part way through a coverage month that carries a charge; `waiting_period_billing_error`, where the charge was raised for a coverage month in which the rider was not yet in force at all; `duplicate_payment_refund`, where the member's own money reached the plan twice for the same coverage month and the duplicate is being returned; `rate_correction`, where the charge was raised at a rider premium rate other than the one the member's rider carries; `medical_plan_ended`, where the charge was raised for a coverage month falling beyond the day the medical plan the rider hangs on ended.
- `credit_amount` — Fixed-format class. The money being credited against that charge, in USD to 2 decimal places, as a plain positive number with no currency sign. It is stored rounded to 2 decimal places.

### What the posting does

The credit is booked to the same coverage month as the charge it relieves, names that charge, is dated with today's date, and the rider premium the member still owes falls by the amount credited. The credit is recorded as having left part of that charge outstanding, relieved it exactly, or exceeded it, according to what the charge came to. The member's rider premium account shows the credit beside the charge it relieves and a lower balance owed.

### Return

A confirmation sentence naming the credit's own newly created reference number, the rider premium charge it was posted against, the coverage month it is booked to, the money credited in USD, the rider premium the member is left owing in USD, and whether the credit left part of that charge outstanding, relieved it exactly or exceeded it. The sentence being returned at all is what indicates the credit has been posted.

## Basis Q&A

**Which coverage month does the credit belong to?** The same coverage month as the charge it relieves.

**Which reason is never right on a credit?** `not_applicable`, which belongs to entries that are not credits at all.

**Which reason covers a charge raised at the wrong rate?** `rate_correction`, where the charge was raised at a rider premium rate other than the one the member's rider carries.
